Scenario fixture: rgaa-format-hint-review (RGAA 11.11)

Each target has a stable id of the form fhr_case_NN. Fields with a pattern, minlength, min/max or inputmode whose label, description and placeholder give no format or example are asked about.

01 — CANTTELL: a pattern with no title nor hint
02 — CANTTELL: a number field with a range and no hint
03 — NOT APPLICABLE: a pattern whose label shows an example
04 — NOT APPLICABLE: a pattern with a title
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: a maxlength only
